column1: # WetherLoggerBox 4MB ESP32-C3: single app (no OTA) + large LittleFS + coredump
# Sized from build result: app binary ~1.17MB -> factory 0x160000 (1.375MB
# A 1MB app is infeasible (binary exceeds it). FS maximized to 0x280000 (2.5MB) while
# keeping a 64KB coredump for WDT/panic post-mortem. (app~1.4M / FS~2.5M)
# Changing offsets reformats LittleFS on next boot (datalog_begin formats on mount-fail).
